name: Aquarium of the Bay
note: sf/waterfront-2.ts, tower() kit: no reference in docs/shots/refs (its one Mapillary frame is marked junk); built from Wikimedia Commons 'Aquarium of the Bay 2025a.jpg' (Commons category 'Aquarium of the Bay - Building'), a clear plaza-side daylight exterior. Two-tier massing following the curved pier-head footprint: navy-blue lower wall with painted mural panels, cream upper band behind a perimeter railing, a small square lantern near the ridge, a run of flagpoles. 'AQUARIUM OF THE BAY' is a real sign() on the plaza-facing wall, not a hand-blocked font. OSM's 15 m tag matches the photo's two-storey-plus-deck scale and is used unmodified.

name: Art Gallery of the Macang Monastery
note: sf/waterfront-2.ts, church() kit: the monastery's own former parish hall, immediately beside way/261273676 (macangMonastery, sf/churches-3.ts). Reference docs/shots/refs/batch5/way-261273687.jpg (its -2.jpg sibling, from inside the monastery's gate, confirms the same adjacency): a modest two-storey cream/stucco gable-roofed hall between the monastery's trees and the modern condo tower next door (outside the photo's corridor, not this building). Built with the SAME church() kit as the monastery -- plain nave, no tower, gable front, sandstone-family material -- so the two read as one property rather than an unrelated box. OSM's 11 m tag matches the photograph's modest scale and is used unmodified.

name: Pier 39
note: BUGS.md #181: OSM's man_made=pier way/199829618 (Nominatim, bbox lat 37.8084-37.8115 lon -122.4114--122.4090) carries no building=yes, so it is placed by lat/lon + size rather than an osm claim, same as the s1.json standalone piers -- and, like them, needs deckAbove to stand on its own datum rather than the flattened sea bed under it. The retail/marina complex is much bigger than what a rider on the Embarcadero actually sees: the render/landmarks/sf/piers.ts pier() kit reused here (style 'plain', matching the neighbouring Piers 33/35 sheds, wider) gives the bulkhead facing the Embarcadero at the pier's landward foot -- right where the Aquarium of the Bay stands beside it -- and the deck's edge and piles running out over the water; front=148 turns the bulkhead to face back down the pier's own axis (shore at x~250,z~1740 to the pier head at x~55,z~2056 in local metres, bearing -32 deg from the shore), not to invent the shops and marina beyond it.
